function: Quantized CSI feedback: a VQ-VAE at each MT compresses pilot observations; the BS decoder gives channel mean and covariance, sampled by SWMMSE for robust precoding (p. 2, p. 3).
system: FDD downlink, BS with 64-element URA (4 x 16) serving J single-antenna MTs; 2.18 GHz; np<N DFT pilots; no RIS (p. 1, p. 2).
method: VQ-VAE with block-Toeplitz covariance decoder; unsupervised offline training on channel samples with Gaussian log-likelihood loss, SNR 0-20 dB; classical SWMMSE builds the precoder (p. 2, p. 3).
data_channel: Measured channels from the Nokia campus, Stuttgart (2017), 2.18 GHz; 400,000 training, 10,000 validation, 10,000 evaluation samples (p. 2, p. 3).
test_conditions: Trained for SNR 0-20 dB; tested on 10,000 held-out samples of the same campaign, sweeping SNR, pilots, MTs (2-16) and feedback bits (p. 2, p. 3, p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: DFT codebook feedback with LS estimate, iterative WMMSE. Learned: regular AE, VQ-VAE-I, GMM-based feedback; DFT also with GMM estimator (p. 3).
metrics: Sum-rate averaged over 500 multi-user constellations versus SNR, number of pilots, number of MTs and feedback bits (p. 3, p. 4, p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "The measurement campaign took place at the Nokia campus"; p. 3: "We use 420,000 data samples from the measurement campaign"; trained and tested on measured channels of one BS site.
q2_support: p. 3: "10,000 for evaluation"; the evaluation set is held out from the same campaign (one site, 2.18 GHz). p. 1: "supports multiuser operation for any number of MTs without requiring" retraining, but J never enters the per-MT VQ-VAE, and the pilot and bit sweeps are not stated as tests of a model trained under other values.
q3_support: p. 3: "As another baseline, we adopt the Gaussian mixture model"; p. 4: "depict the sum-rate over the SNR"; learned AE [5], VQ-VAE-I and GMM [16] and the non-learned DFT codebook scheme with LS estimate are all compared on the sum-rate (Figs. 3 to 6).
q4_support: p. 4: "cost of increased complexity of the forward pass"; only qualitative remarks on complexity, with no parameter count, operations or runtime of the VQ-VAE or the SWMMSE reported anywhere in the paper.
q5_support: p. 2: "The measurement campaign took place at the Nokia campus"; p. 3: "We use 420,000 data samples from the measurement campaign"; trains and tests on measured data, but the paper gives no code or data link.
notes: PDF checked: title and DOI 10.1109/LWC.2024.3503066 on p. 1 match. Area 2 chosen because the learned VQ-VAE only compresses, feeds back and synthesizes the channel, while the precoder comes from the classical SWMMSE; the sum-rate is the downstream metric, so area 3 is a possible alternative reading. q1 and q5 are met through the measured-data clause only: the measurement data are not released with a link. q2: Fig. 5 varies the number of MTs (2 to 16) with the same model and p. 1 says no retraining is needed, but the VQ-VAE is trained on single-MT channels and J does not enter it, so I did not count it as a new condition; the reviewer may confirm. The complexity remarks on p. 4 and p. 5 are qualitative.
